ModMetaData.name: Machine Vigil
ModMetaData.author: Nahuel
ModMetaData.description:
When a mechanitor dies, their mechanoids do not simply wander off.
Cut loose from the mechlink, they walk to the body and stand in a silent ring around it, facing it, until someone else takes command. If the body is carried away or buried, the ring follows it to the grave. Colonists who see the machines keeping vigil are touched by it.
- Uncontrolled mechs of a dead mechanitor gather 2-3 cells from the corpse (or the grave or sarcophagus holding it) and stand facing it. - They stay awake: the vanilla rules for mechs going feral still apply. They still defend themselves if attacked. - When a new mechanitor connects to one of them, it wakes from the vigil with a flash; the rest keep standing. - The vigil ends when every mech is reclaimed, dies or goes feral, or after 3 days. - Colonists within 6 cells who can see the body get a small mood memory (-2, 1 day), once per vigil.
Requires Biotech. Safe to add to an existing save. Only affects mechs that use the vanilla Mechanoid think tree.
